title: folded-sheet-fracture: code and data for "Cracks running into the ridge of a folded sheet"
description: Python solvers (singular integral equations, Gauss-Chebyshev collocation), COMSOL 6.4 Java files for every shell finite-element test, and the resulting data, for a straight crack running at right angles into the ridge of a folded thin sheet, in modes I, II and III.

creators.name: Barbieri, Ettore
creators.affiliation: Japan Agency for Marine-Earth Science and Technology (JAMSTEC)
